upstream_integration.description: Pinned Git-submodule support; no changes to rch-common or rchd production paths.
RABS delivery/admission and RCH clean-overlay/source-content changes; no changes to rch-common or rchd. CLI validation must use the incorporated source.

final_integration_binaries.scope: Executables after the administrative-persistence correction and CLI alias fix, used by the completed final daemon/job lifecycle suites. These hashes do not replace the earlier process-measurement executable identity.

provenance.candidate_scope: Working-tree issue-128 changes are identified by executable hash. The earlier process measurements precede the final common-store correction requiring a durable clear of volatile-only disable intent; that correction has a separate completed common-suite rerun below. Final executable builds, CLI regressions, and lifecycle suites have their own later evidence and binary identities.
provenance.earlier_evidence_note: The original a1fe627c comparison and its raw JSON are preserved separately and are not relabeled as current-main results.

measurement_limits: Local deterministic worker protocols exercise actual daemon scheduling/reservations and SSH process lifecycles. OpenSSH mode performs real local client/server authentication; subprocess mode instruments a local SSH protocol fixture.
No external worker, actual remote compilation, live Tailscale/VPN traffic, or original RCH 1.x executable was measured. The reporter's traffic/log rates were not reproduced or claimed.
Current-main baseline idle disable/restart and authenticated-session freeze cases already passed. These cases are preservation checks, not newly fixed behavior.
Process peaks are sampled; a fast refused dial can have sampled peak zero while the independently recorded dial count is nonzero.

Small local p95 samples, CPU accounting and RSS observations are retained without a general latency, CPU or memory performance claim. The measured candidate's disabled-phase CPU time can be higher than baseline.

results.transport: local OpenSSH with deterministic worker protocol

baseline_authenticated_freeze.evidence_kind: Two successful focused run_warm_transport_freeze invocations against the 4a3fac5f baseline; observed summaries, not newly generated full results.json files.
baseline_authenticated_freeze.harness_correction: The initial warm-fixture setup timed out before injecting any outage because the second pool had not warmed. The fixture now exercises actual toolchain preflight to establish both authenticated pools; both focused baseline reruns passed. The failed setup is not production failure evidence.

baseline_regression_evidence.method: Focused added regressions executed against the baseline implementation. Expected failures demonstrate remaining defects; console logs are embedded below.

reproduced_failures.observed: Revoking benchmark network permission did not stop the SSH proxy descendant; the ownership assertion timed out.
Retired-endpoint prober called once; expected zero.
Successful enable affected a retired worker object rather than the current replacement.

Before virtual time was advanced, the SSH fixture logged a physical subprocess dial and returned a confirmed cancellation receipt despite current-endpoint transport-down evidence; baseline returned cancelled and released one slot instead of deferring.
